definitions.name: billed
definitions.label: Billed
definitions.meaning: Invoice value excluding tax, by invoice date. A correction replaces the earlier claim; credit notes are separate refunds.

definitions.name: received
definitions.label: Received
definitions.meaning: Settled cash receipts excluding bounced or cancelled payments, by settlement date.

definitions.name: earned
definitions.label: Earned
definitions.meaning: Goods delivered to the buyer excluding tax, by delivery date; fulfilled order events must be imported explicitly. Platform fees and shipping are separately classified cost events.

definitions.name: refunds
definitions.label: Refunds
definitions.meaning: Positive value of credit notes or returns, by credit note date, deducted once from earned sales.

definitions.name: costs
definitions.label: Costs
definitions.meaning: Order or period costs excluding recoverable tax; includes goods, shipping, platform fees and advertising only where explicitly imported.

definitions.name: purchases
definitions.label: Purchases
definitions.meaning: Purchase register value excluding tax, by invoice date.

country.name: India

tax.label: GST
tax.registrationNote: Service businesses usually register for GST above a yearly turnover of INR 20 lakh (INR 10 lakh in special category states). Some must register earlier. Check with a CA.

complianceNotes: Customer personal data falls under the DPDP Act and its rules.
Commercial SMS needs DLT registration, so Chausar does not send SMS.
Export of services is zero-rated only under an LUT and with payment in foreign currency. Check with a CA.
